title: Execution within a cost bound
statement: Given limits, a program, a depth parameter, a statement, an initial state, a natural-number cost bound $T$, and a predicate $Q$ on states, the execution satisfies this condition exactly when there are a final state and a cost such that executing the statement from the initial state reaches that final state with that cost, the cost is at most $T$, and $Q$ holds of the final state.
